name: 办公文档能力包
description: 支持PDF、Word、Excel、PPT文档解析、格式互转、批量处理、编辑修改、数据变换、PDF操控、高级排版、邮件合并、文档比较、打包压缩与文档脱敏，实现文档整理、数据汇总与报告输出

displayDescription.en: Comprehensive office document toolkit: parse, convert, batch-process, edit, transform, manipulate PDFs, style reports, mail merge, compare, archive and redact across PDF, Word, Excel, PPT.
displayDescription.zh: 支持PDF、Word、Excel、PPT文档解析、格式互转、批量处理、编辑修改、数据变换、PDF操控、高级排版、邮件合并、文档比较、打包与脱敏

defaultInitInput.zh: 帮我把这50个Excel文件合并成一个表
defaultInitInput.en: Merge these 50 Excel files into one table

quickInputs.en: Merge these 50 Excel files into one table
quickInputs.zh: 帮我把这50个Excel文件合并成一个表

quickInputs.en: Compare the differences between these two Word documents
quickInputs.zh: 比较这两个Word文档的差异

quickInputs.en: Fill Word template with Excel data to batch generate contracts
quickInputs.zh: 用这份Excel数据批量填充Word模板生成合同

displayDescription.en: Parse PDF, Word, Excel, PPT files to extract text, tables and structured content.
displayDescription.zh: 解析PDF、Word、Excel、PPT文件，提取文本、表格与结构化内容

displayDescription.en: Generate PDF, Word, Excel, PPT files from structured content and templates.
displayDescription.zh: 根据结构化内容与模板生成PDF、Word、Excel、PPT文件

displayDescription.en: Aggregate, summarize and organize multi-source data into structured reports.
displayDescription.zh: 汇总、整理多源数据并生成结构化报告

displayDescription.en: Convert between PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, PPT and Markdown formats.
Batch rename, merge Excel/Word, batch convert formats and traverse folders.
displayDescription.zh: 批量重命名、合并多个Excel/Word、批量转格式、遍历文件夹

displayDescription.en: Edit existing Word/Excel/PPT: replace text, append content, write cells, apply templates, track changes.
displayDescription.zh: 编辑已有Word/Excel/PPT：替换文本、追加内容、写入单元格、套用模板、修订追踪

displayDescription.en: Vlookup, pivot, filter, dedupe, encoding convert, sort, split/merge text.
displayDescription.zh: vlookup合并、数据透视、筛选去重、编码清洗、排序、文本拆分/合并

displayDescription.en: Merge, split, compress, encrypt, watermark and extract pages/images from PDFs.
displayDescription.zh: PDF合并、拆分、压缩、加密、加水印、提取指定页/图片

displayDescription.en: Add auto TOC, header/footer, charts, cover page and unified theme to Word/PPT.
displayDescription.zh: Word自动目录、页眉页脚页码、图表插入、封面页、统一主题样式

displayDescription.en: Batch fill Word templates with Excel/CSV data to generate personalized documents.
displayDescription.zh: 用Excel/CSV数据批量填充Word模板生成个性化文档

displayDescription.en: Compare two Word/Excel/PDF/CSV documents and output added, removed and modified content.
displayDescription.zh: 对比两个Word/Excel/PDF/CSV文档差异，输出增删改内容

displayDescription.en: Pack multiple files into ZIP or extract ZIP archives.
displayDescription.zh: 将多个文件打包成ZIP或解压ZIP压缩包

displayDescription.en: Auto-detect and redact sensitive info (ID, phone, email, bank card) in documents.
displayDescription.zh: 自动识别并遮盖文档中的身份证号、手机号、邮箱、银行卡号等敏感信息
